saw_lines: Men rarely buy a tie on impulse. They buy one for a wedding or interview, then return for the next occasion.
So the sale is won by naming the occasion in line one, since a general pitch gives no reason to buy now.
Your 18 Google ads mix 9 image, 7 text and 2 video creatives. Build three occasion ads for wedding and gift buyers, each one closing on your free shipping offer.
ads_1: Occasion led Google creative for wedding and gift buyers, free shipping in the close
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram, Pinterest, Twitter and Youtube
